component.name: xTerminal Pro
component.summary: Enterprise Multi-Protocol SSH, Serial, Telnet and DevOps Workstation

description.p: xTerminal Pro is an ultra-fast, modern, and secure terminal workstation engineered for DevOps professionals, cloud architects, sysadmins, and network engineers.

ul.li: Multi-Protocol Terminal: SSHv2, Telnet, Serial Console (COM/TTY), and Android ADB.
Multi-Host Command Orchestrator: Execute commands across multiple target servers in parallel.
Live Telemetry & SFTP: Server CPU, RAM, and network monitoring with integrated SFTP manager.
Real-time Multiplayer Collaboration: Securely share live terminal sessions with your team.
Universal Session Importer: Migrate sessions from PuTTY, Termius, SecureCRT, and OpenSSH.

screenshot.caption: System Health and Server Telemetry Dashboard

description.p: xTerminal Pro v1.2.7 release with multi-platform packaging, enhanced stability, and Store integration.
